name: effect-fence-hold-content-claim-absent-no-recorded-hash
description: HOLD reason `content_claim_absent` -- the EIGHTH reason, and the forced half of the pair this fixture set exists to pin. The preflight pre-read carries NO content_hash, so the artifact is registered at version 1 with no recorded content claim and the coordinator cannot vouch that any bytes are the content at that version. THE TWIN IS 07: its request body is BYTE-IDENTICAL to this one, and the ONLY difference between the two workspaces is whether the preflight pre-read carried a content_hash. Before content_claim_absent existed these two cases were indistinguishable on the wire -- the empty recorded hash made `hash_differs` false (it needs a truthy recorded hash on BOTH sides), so the generation was never demoted and the effect fired against a value nothing backs. A regression that folds this reason back into the residual bucket makes 06 and 07 answer the same string and turns this fixture red. The recoveries differ and that is why the split is load-bearing: re-read your bytes here, check the daemon's version and call an operator there.
